sections.title: Defining the Problem: ODE vs. PDE
lecture_lines: ODEs track change in one variable, like time.
PDEs model complex phenomena across multiple variables.
Think of a single pendulum versus pond ripples.
animations: Display text: 'ODE: One Variable' and 'PDE: Many Variables' in separate columns. Color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Visualizing Multidimensional Change
lecture_lines: Partial derivatives measure change along specific axes.
Imagine a terrain; slope varies in x and y.
Heat maps visualize these gradients on surfaces.

sections.title: The Core Equation: The Heat Equation
lecture_lines: The heat equation links diffusion to spatial curvature.
Rate of temperature change equals the diffusion rate.
Visualize heat spreading from a warm radiator.
Curvature drives the flow of heat over time.
animations: Display Heat Equation: 'u_t = alpha * u_xx'. Color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Boundary and Initial Conditions
lecture_lines: PDEs require context to solve uniquely.
Initial conditions define the starting state.
Boundary conditions constrain the edges of space.
animations: Show a flat horizontal line at y=0. Color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Applications and Wrap-up
lecture_lines: PDEs are the fundamental language of nature.
They govern fluids, electromagnetism, and quantum fields.
Real-time solvers handle complex environmental turbulence.
PDEs unlock mastery over physical reality.
